posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: Greetings! Now that there is more information (and more topics) on GSF, I've re-organized the GSF section of the forum and moved a few topics around. The GSF category now has a "Rules and Gameplay" board as well as a "World" board, for symetry with the SotM category (future GSF boards will be created on an as-needed basis). I've also moved a few topics, such as general discussions of the GSF Kickstarter, into the General Discussions board, since they releate to general GTG type stuff (like the rest of the stuff there).
